name: case
description: One case of a flow (e.g. a site), at /app/cases/:code: a header, then one tab per non-empty region among overview, tasks, activity and documents. The open tab is kept in the URL (?tab=).

regions.description: Above the tabs: the case's code, title, status and stage tracker.
Tasks tab: the case's open tasks and decision history.
Activity tab: what happened on the case.
